name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
one_liner: A tool that makes websites built by AI coding assistants look like a real designer made them, instead of the generic 'AI slop' look.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small digital agency who builds client sites with AI coding tools and needs the output to look professional enough to hand to a paying client.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer runs every AI-built landing page through it before client delivery, cutting down on 'this looks AI-generated' revision requests.
A small web agency standardizes its AI-assisted build pipeline on it so junior staff ship senior-level visual polish without hiring a dedicated designer.
A no-code consultant uses the theme catalog to give each client site a distinct look instead of the same templated feel every AI tool produces.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'de-AI-slop' polish pass as a paid add-on to existing website-build or landing-page services.
Bundle it into a monthly website-maintenance retainer that keeps client sites visually current.

steal_this: Re-skin three existing AI-built client sites this weekend with it and pitch the before/after as a free upgrade to land a maintenance retainer.
